purpose: Development round of the masked context network as a second member on top of v51's model part (the user: 'go ahead with the masked network round', 30 September 2026). The design batch passed two items; the combination went to the first round and became v51; this round tests the other item, the masked network on rows without an ADS-B match, added to v51's network table. Declared before any fit of these seeds and before any development score of this member.
disclosed: Known before this declaration: the design batch's readings on the October design fold (route_m25: standalone -0.66%, unmatched rows 209.91 against 212.13 s, better at all nine airports); the combination round's development readings (the combination member on unmatched non-LIRF rows about equal to the shipped table); v51's official score (222.2306). The item, the candidate grid (the combination round's 0.15 / 0.25 / 0.40) and the rule were fixed by those earlier records; nothing in this round is derived from the official score.

base_members.note: v51's model part: the combination member at weight 0.40 in the network table. On the development rows the control built with it must reproduce the combination round's recorded w40 month RMSEs; on the ranking rows it must reproduce the member file v51 was reconciled from.

member.name: mask_unmatched
member.routing: per seed and leaf: the m25_32 network's prediction on rows with adsb_matched = 0 (tools/build_combo_member.py with this declaration); rows with a match carry no member value and keep v51's table; LIRF rows are left to the shipped table by the scorer

fits.footing: January and July 2025: leave-one-month-out on the other eleven months of 2025; November: the forward fold (reported only); December: the January-November refit; ranking: the twelve-month refit. Equal to the control rows' footing (runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet) and to the combination round's.
fits.runner: tools/run_adsb_ctx_lomo.py, unchanged; jobs tools/combo_jobs.py --declaration; queue tools/combo_queue.sh

hardware: four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each) via SkyPilot (infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20260930.json), tools/run_adsb_ctx_lomo.py --device cuda, float32 with TF32 matrix products, two lanes per GPU; fewer nodes of the same type if AWS cannot supply four. GPU for turnaround: about 3-4 hours against about 29 hours on the eight Azure CPU workers. Any other hardware would be an amendment recorded before its fits.
semantics: tools/run_network_member.py with base members: table_base = (1 - 0.40) x (0.25 e24 + 0.25 e24b + 0.5 e32) + 0.40 x combo_all (v51's member) on non-LIRF rows where both are finite; table' = (1 - w) x table_base + w x mask member seed mean on non-LIRF rows without a match; the mix is v46's on table' (network share 0.85; share 0.5 where the committee sits more than 1,200 s above table'); then the whole v46 development stack. Control = the same with w = 0: v51's model part.
rule: the clean line's unchanged rule (the scorer's defaults): eligible when no equal-footing month (January, July, December) is worse on all rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1 and every equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; the lowest mean ratio among the eligible is selected; otherwise nothing
never_read: No official score enters. The published daily totals enter only the export step (configs/daily_totals_v1.json applied last, as for v51), never a development score.
export_plan: if a candidate is selected and the user says so: the control's ranking values must reproduce v51's member file; the candidate member file is written as a dry run (no version number); configs/daily_totals_v1.json is applied last with tools/export_daily_totals.py --base; the versioned file is the reconciled one.
